title: Featured Projects
text:
ADVISOR integrates computer vision, air quality sensors, wearable devices, and data fusion methods to support transportation safety, operations, and resilience research.
Platform components include:

Computer vision for object detection and tracking
Air quality and environmental sensors, including PM2.5, NO2, and weather data
Wearable sensing for heart rate and stress-related measures
Data fusion, analytics, visualization, and reporting workflows





Multimodal activity analysis using computer vision
Identification of peak demand patterns and safety risks
Generation of high-resolution trajectory and count data





Quantification of curbside violations and dwell times
Identification of operational conflicts affecting transit
Recommendations for curbside redesign and improved access management





Use of wearable sensors to measure stress in real environments
Identification of high-risk locations using physiological data
Support for human-centered infrastructure design

title: Core Capabilities
text:
Core Capabilities
ADVISOR supports research and applied transportation projects through integrated sensing, analytics, and visualization capabilities.


High-Resolution Multimodal Mobility Data
Collection and analysis of pedestrian, cyclist, vehicle, transit, and curbside activity.


Real-Time Detection and Post-Processed Analytics
Computer vision workflows for object detection, tracking, classification, and event extraction.


Curbside Behavior and Obstruction Analysis
Measurement of dwell time, double parking, occupancy, compliance, and access conflicts.


Intersection and Crossing Insights
Evaluation of pedestrian activity, crossings, conflicts, and near-miss patterns.


Operational Traffic and Access Patterns
Analysis of circulation, lane use, origin-destination patterns, and peak demand.


Non-Motorized Mobility and Stress Detection
Use of wearable sensors to understand pedestrian and cyclist stress in real environments.


Environmental and Behavioral Data Integration
Fusion of air quality, weather, physiological, and mobility data for richer decision-making.

title: ADVISOR
text:
Key Focus Areas


Evidence-Based Planning
Transportation planning supported by high-resolution multimodal data and analytics.


Safety Risk Identification
Detection of conflict zones, near misses, and operational safety risks.


Operational Efficiency
Analysis of access, circulation, curbside use, dwell time, and movement patterns.


Human Experience
Integration of stress, environmental exposure, and behavioral data into transport policy.

title: ADVISOR
text:
Featured Projects


Traffic Mobility: Medical Center Drive
Multimodal activity analysis using computer vision to identify peak demand patterns, safety risks, and high-resolution trajectory and count data.


Curbside Management: Sarratt Circle
Analysis of curbside violations, dwell times, and operational conflicts affecting transit and access.


Pedestrian Stress Study
Wearable sensor-based analysis of stress in real environments to support human-centered infrastructure design.

title: About ADVISOR
text:
ADVISOR combines sensing and analytics systems to study multimodal transportation, human behavior, and environmental conditions in real-world settings. The enterprise connects computer vision, wearable sensing, environmental monitoring, and data analytics to generate actionable insights for safe, efficient, and resilient outcomes.


To empower researchers, practitioners, agencies, and community partners with data-driven tools that improve transportation safety, operations, and resilience.



To advance transportation systems that are safer, more efficient, more resilient, and more responsive to human experience.
